newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil continues uptrend at close.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil continues uptrend at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Heavy short-covering based on technical factors. Strong close of Chicago soyoil on Wednesday helped early rise in domestic prices. Local rally seen continuing if overnight Chicago market remains firm on Thursday. New local support seen at 1,220 ringgit while resistance at 1,240.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Little follow-through buying, with players seeming unconvinced of any fundamentals in futures.
Traders said buying was seen through the day, although profit-taking shaved gains a little.
At the close, the August third-month futures contract ended 12 ringgit higher at 1,227 ringgit ($488.84) a tonne. Double-digit gains were also seen in most other contracts.
Trading volume on the futures market was 2,633 lots.
Physicals were a shade higher than Wednesday, but there was a lack of follow-through strong buying. "I think players did not see any fundamentals in the futures' activity," said a trader.
Physical June (south) saw offers at 1,285 against bids at 1,280 with earlier trades done at 1,277.50 and 1,280.
June (central) saw offers at 1,275 after bids at 1,270 and deals done at 1,265 to 1,270.
July (south) saw offers at 1,275 after bids of 1,270 and trade of 1,265 to 1,270.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered at $537.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, July at $532.50 and Aug/Sept at $527.50.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $575, July at $570, and Aug/Sept at $565 and July/Aug/Sept at $567.50. July was traded at $570, while July/Aug/Sept was done at $565.
June RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $272.50.
